responsibility: This definition module declares mc’s binary-tree mapping from interned names to arbitrary symbol payloads. It provides initialization, insertion, deletion, lookup, emptiness testing, predicate-based search, and in-order traversal, and serves as the generic scoped-symbol-table interface used by decl and related modules to manage module and local symbol namespaces.
same_name_distinction: This is the public definition module for the symbolKey container, declaring the opaque symbolTree type and exported tree operations. Unlike symbolKey.mod, it does not define the tree node record or implement insertion, lookup, deletion, and traversal algorithms.
